query:
Find applicable evidence-backed ways to reduce execution time in this GitHub Actions workflow. Consider its jobs, dependencies, commands, triggers, and repository manifests.
name: MSBuild

on:
  push:
    branches: ["master"]
  pull_request:
    branches: ["master"]
  workflow_dispatch:
  schedule:
    # Rebuild monthly so the artifacts (90 day retention) never expire
    - cron: "0 0 1 * *"

env:
  SOLUTION_FILE_PATH: .
  BUILD_CONFIGURATION: Release

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: windows-latest

    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Add MSBuild to PATH
        uses: microsoft/setup-msbuild@v2

      - name: Restore NuGet packages
        working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
        run: nuget restore ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}

      - name: Build Reboot
        working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
        run: msbuild ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}} /t:Clean,Build /p:Configuration=Release

      - name: Upload Artifact without ABOVE_S20
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: Reboot
          path: ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}/x64/Release
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

      - name: Build RebootS20
        working-directory: ${{env.GITHUB_WORKSPACE}}
        run: msbuild ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}} /p:AboveS20=TRUE /t:Clean,Build /p:Configuration=Release

      - name: Upload Artifact with ABOVE_S20
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: RebootS20
          path: ${{env.SOLUTION_FILE_PATH}}/x64/Release
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 90

  # GitHub disables scheduled workflows after 60 days without repo activity.
  # Re-enabling the workflow through the API resets that timer without a commit.
  keepalive:
    if: github.event_name == 'schedule'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      actions: write
    steps:
      - name: Reset inactivity timer
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: gh api -X PUT "repos/${{ github.repository }}/actions/workflows/msbuild.yml/enable"

results.content:
Suppress schedules during repository inactivity

Pattern: P-LIT-IDLE-SCHEDULE (scheduled_run_reduction)

When is suppress schedules during repository inactivity applicable?

Assess suppress schedules during repository inactivity for this repository, preserve its required checks, and propose a minimal change or NO_CHANGE.

Preconditions: Periodic results depend only on repository changes

Contraindications: External dependencies, security or time-based requirements need fresh checks

Method: Identify meaningful activity rather than generated self-updates; Resume when relevant inputs change

Reported finding: Inactivity suppression saves some scheduled work.

Reported metrics: {"paid_scheduled_vm_time_reduction_percent": 1.1}

Source: Resource Usage and Optimization Opportunities in Workflows of GitHub Actions (2024), 4.3.2; Table 5; PDF pp. 8, 9: https://software-lab.org/publications/icse2024_workflows.pdf
